name: Matter3D Inc
summary: Canadian filament brand reportedly manufactured in Victoria, BC, selling Performance PLA/PETG plus matte, glitter-silk and carbon-fibre variants through distributors such as 3D Printing Canada/USA, Lee's Electronics and RobotShop. Self-describes as formulating its own additives on base resins from Dow, Chemours, SABIC and NatureWorks (uncorroborated).
additional_notes: Not to be confused with MatterHackers. SimplyPrint lists 7 lines (4 PLA, 3 PETG) with temperatures. Base-resin suppliers (Dow, Chemours, SABIC, NatureWorks) are raw-material sourcing claims, not OEM relationships, and are self-described via madeinca.ca. Distribution by 3D Printing Canada is recorded on that entry. Price tier (mid) unverified, so omitted.

provenance.conflicts: Victoria, BC location and in-house manufacturing come from a directory listing (madeinca.ca), not first-party corporate data; incorporation of 'Matter3D Inc' not verified.
